integrity: Analytic proof from gnomonic surface Jacobian, single-segment directional flux, two-line coarea Jacobian and convergent Fourier series; Monte Carlo and numerical quadrature provide corroboration, not independent mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: The scalar four-point crossing probability is implied by earlier halfsphere-polytope results and is not new; claimed contribution is the fully evaluated spatial crossing-location density for specified endpoint sampling. Other crossing-location conventions, sampling laws and historical unindexed equivalents are not classified.
title: Spatial crossing-point law for independent geodesics in a hemisphere
